title: duplicaterulecondition
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, regardingobjectid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the condition was created.

ignoreblankvalues.description: Determines whether to consider blank values as non-duplicate values

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

matchingattributename.description: Field that is being compared with the base field.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the condition was last modified.

operatorparam.description: Parameter value of N if the operator is Same First Characters or Same Last Characters.

owningbusinessunit.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the condition.

owninguser.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the condition.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the condition.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the duplicate rule condition.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the condition.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the duplicate rule condition.

_regardingobjectid_value.description: Unique identifier of the object with which the condition is associated.
